completeness_scope: Recorded NR_FeMIMO-Core Resolution-referenced CR target families with independently documented individual TSG approval and normative TS history incorporation. No causal or whole-authored CR completeness claim.
original_query: MATCH (w:WorkItem {workItemCode: 'NR_FeMIMO-Core'})<-[:RELATED_TO]-(cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec) MATCH (res:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(cr) RETURN sp.specNumber AS spec, count(DISTINCT res) AS resolutionCount, count(DISTINCT cr) AS crCount ORDER BY resolutionCount DESC
question_en: Which TSs did resolutions on NR_FeMIMO-Core CRs land in? (how this work item's decisions entered the standard)
reference_query:
MATCH (wi:WorkItem {workItemCode: 'NR_FeMIMO-Core'})<-[:RELATED_TO]-(cr:CR)
MATCH (res:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(cr)
MATCH (cr)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec)
WHERE sp.specRelease IS NULL
MATCH (cr)-[:HAS_SOURCE_INCORPORATION_OBSERVATION]->(observation:SourceCRNormativeIncorporationObservation)
      -[:DOCUMENTS_SPEC]->(sp)
WHERE observation.individualTSGStatus = 'approved'
  AND observation.normativeHistoryNewVersion IS NOT NULL
  AND trim(observation.normativeHistoryNewVersion) <> ''
RETURN DISTINCT sp.specNumber AS specNumber
